title: canarium fugax
intro: Canarium fugax, commonly known as the 'Kurrajong' or 'Canarium tree', is a species of evergreen tree in the family Sapindaceae. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of Canarium fugax include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
